failure_condition: Normal-size text has contrast below 4.5:1 against its background.
expected_outcome: The control meets the 4.5:1 normal-text threshold; the defect falls below it.
manual_verification_method: Verify effective rendered colors, font size/weight, opacity, and applicable exceptions.
dom_testability: Can estimate contrast from computed styles only for the simple opaque colors in this fixture.
accessibility_tree_testability: Not testable from Accessibility Tree semantics alone.
limitations: Computed styles do not generally resolve images, gradients, transparency, overlays, or every applicable exception.
